title: Clam soup
lead:
{{Short description|Soup prepared with clams}}
[[File:Clam soup.JPG|thumb|upright=1.1|Clam soup]]
[[File:Villorita cyprinoides 004 Black clam miso soup in a Japanese restaurant in Tokyo.JPG|thumb|Black clam [[miso soup]] at a Tokyo restaurant]]

'''Clam soup''' is a soup prepared using [[clam]]s as a primary ingredient. Clam soup can be prepared as a thin, [[broth]]- or cream/milk-based soup and as a thicker, [[chowder]]-style soup. In Japan, hot [[miso soup]] prepared with clams is believed by some to be a cure for the [[hangover]].
